blurb: Guests paddle through a salt marsh ecosystem on calm, protected waters of Swan River. The area is family-friendly with gentle currents and abundant wildlife including swans, herons, egrets, ospreys, ducks, and more. The business has served families for over 40 years as a top destination for outdoor adventures on Cape Cod.

quotes.author: Katie H. -
quotes.text: They have friendly workers, competitively priced, and very fair in their rates. They charge for 1 1/2, but give you 1/2 hour window of flexibility. We were a party of 4 and they could have easily charged another 40 on top of the 85 it cost, but let the additional 40 minutes go without a charge. That left us enough time to kayak down the river (against the current, have a swim at the beach, relax and kayak back. We will continue to use this company.

quotes.author: Amy M. -
quotes.text: Amazing! There is plenty of parking, perfect location on a sleepy river. You can head to the pond or down to the Sound, and the kayaks, canoes, SUP are very kid friendly. They have beautiful facilities with cleanest bathrooms on the Cape. Staff is sooooo nice — laid back. And when it rained on us we got a full refund. But no worries, we will return. These folks are the best! Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Rachael C. -
quotes.text: It was a beautiful facility that’s was nicely run. The staff was helpful and very courteous. The girl behind the desk gave us a great suggestion due to the tide. It was a beautiful meandering course to the beach. We took a quick swim and headed back. 1-1/2 hours was plenty of time. Bring waters, it was a bit of a workout going against the tide paddling out. I would definitely do this again!

quotes.author: Cpierce47 - (North Brookfiled
quotes.text: A fun way to spend an afternoon! Staff is super friendly and helpful, the paddle boats are in excellent condition, the view is beautiful. My husband, five year old, and I all fit in one paddle boat comfortably. Our older son and his friend took another paddle boat and it was easy enough for them to navigate and control the boat. Great family afternoon on the water!

quotes.author: Rachael Caliman -
quotes.text: I highly recommend this place. It was a clean and organized facility, and the staff was so nice and courteous. They even made a great suggestion to ride against the tide going out so we’d have a relaxing ride in and she was RIGHT! Bring water and wear a bathing suit so you can go for a dip at the beach before paddling back.

quotes.author: Google User -
quotes.text: Amazing! I absolutely loved it here. The staff was friendly and welcoming! This was so much fun and at an amazing price. We went in a paddle boat up the river, the staff informed us about water current and what animals we could see during our trip, it was really great and relaxing! Would definitely go here again
